name: Ichijou Mitsuki
source: The assistant to the school director Ryuuzouji Kouzou and former history teacher at Sakaimachi Academy. Mitsuki and Takuya have a history with each other and remain good friends. Her workload has increased heavily in the weeks leading up to the game, which seems to have impacted her in some way.
